title: Biomedical Knowledge Composition: A Software Engineering Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2608.08927v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biomedical research has accumulated vast molecular, clinical, and population data, yet translating this wealth into actionable knowledge remains constrained by technical and organizational difficulties. This article presents a unified treatment of two perspectives on biomedical knowledge infrastructure. The first introduces the biomedical domain to software engineers: it explains why knowledge graphs (KGs) are the central integrative data structure in modern biomedicine, characterizes five data harmonization challenges (identifier mapping, entity resolution, schema alignment, evidence integration, and provenance tracking), surveys application domains from drug discovery to digital twins, and profiles six representative KG systems with contrasting choices. The second perspective asks why engineering biomedical knowledge infrastructure remains so difficult. We argue that a contributing root cause is limited adoption of software tooling

translated_title: 生物医学知识构建：软件工程视角
translated_abstract: 生物医学研究已经积累了海量的分子、临床和人群数据，然而将这些丰富的数据转化为可操作的知识仍受到技术和组织方面困难的制约。本文对生物医学知识基础设施的两个视角进行了统一阐述。第一个视角是向软件工程师介绍生物医学领域：解释了为什么知识图谱是现代生物医学中核心的集成数据结构，刻画了五大数据协调挑战（标识符映射、实体消解、模式对齐、证据整合和溯源追踪），调查了从药物发现到数字孪生等应用领域，并介绍了六个具有不同设计选择的代表性知识图谱系统。第二个视角则探讨为什么生物医学知识基础设施的工程化构建仍然如此困难。我们认为，一个促成性的根本原因是软件工具的采用不足。
tldr: 本文从软件工程视角统一阐述生物医学知识基础设施，向软件工程师介绍知识图谱及五大数据协调挑战，并指出软件工具采用不足是生物医学知识基础设施工程化困难的一个根本原因。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a unified software engineering perspective on biomedical knowledge infrastructure, introducing knowledge graphs and five data harmonization challenges to software engineers, and arguing that limited adoption of software tooling is a contributing root cause of why engineering biomedical knowledge infrastructure remains difficult.
